changesApplied.changeMade: Added template_lifecycle_automation config section with: enabled (default: true), auto_evolve_on_staleness (default: true), staleness_threshold_days (default: 30), auto_debug_on_failure (default: true), failure_threshold_count (default: 3), max_evolution_frequency_hours (default: 168)
changesApplied.reason: Enables users to control when/how templates are automatically improved. Without this config, lifecycle automation would be hardcoded and inflexible. This allows fine-tuning of staleness detection, failure thresholds, and evolution frequency.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Low risk - New config section, backward compatible (all fields optional with safe defaults). Consumers: boredom-manager.ts and activity.ts will read this config to decide whether to trigger meta-templates.

changesApplied.changeMade: Added template mapping logic: 'improve-template' → 'evolve-activity-self-contained', 'debug-failures' → 'debug-activity-self-contained', 'optimize-performance' → 'optimize-activity-self-contained'. Changed from executing boredomActivity.template_id directly to executing meta-template with templateId as variable.
changesApplied.reason: CRITICAL FIX: Previously, boredom system executed stale templates directly instead of meta-templates. This broke self-improvement loop. Now when backend says 'improve template X', we execute evolve-activity-self-contained with templateId=X as input, which actually improves the template.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Medium risk - Changes core boredom execution flow. Blast radius: BoredomManager.executeBoredomActivity() is only called from BoredomManager.monitorIdleActivity(). Impact: Boredom activities now correctly invoke meta-templates for template improvement instead of running stale templates. Requires meta-templates (evolve/debug-activity-self-contained) to exist as bootstrap templates (already present).

changesApplied.changeMade: Added maybeAutoDebugFailedActivity() helper function that checks config and triggers debug-activity-self-contained when activities fail. Called after activity.status='failed' and Activity.save() in executeActivityInline(). Function checks config.metabob.template_lifecycle_automation.auto_debug_on_failure and triggers debug-activity with executionId as variable.
changesApplied.reason: CRITICAL FIX: Previously, activities failed without any automated analysis. Now when templates fail, the system automatically triggers debug-activity-self-contained to analyze the failure and generate fix recommendations. This completes the self-improvement loop: detect failure → analyze → recommend fixes → apply → evolve.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Medium risk - Adds background debugging on failure. Blast radius: executeActivityInline() is called from ActivityTool.execute(), BoredomManager, and lifecycle hooks. Impact: Failed activities now trigger debug analysis automatically. Non-blocking (wrapped in try-catch). May increase background activity load when templates fail repeatedly. Debug activity runs in separate session, doesn't interfere with parent.

dataFlowChanges.before: User creates template → ActivityTemplate.create() → maybeAutoRegisterWithMetabob() → TemplateRepository.save() → MetabobCLI.registerActivityTemplate() → metabob_register_activity_template MCP
dataFlowChanges.impact: No change - auto-registration was already implemented correctly

dataFlowChanges.before: Idle 5min → fetchBoredomActivities() → metabob_fetch_boredom_activities MCP → Returns {activity_type: 'improve-template', template_id: 'stale-template'} → executeBoredomActivity('stale-template', variables) → WRONG: Executes stale template directly
dataFlowChanges.after: Idle 5min → fetchBoredomActivities() → metabob_fetch_boredom_activities MCP → Returns {activity_type: 'improve-template', template_id: 'stale-template'} → Map activity_type to meta-template ('evolve-activity-self-contained') → executeBoredomActivity('evolve-activity-self-contained', {templateId: 'stale-template', ...metrics}) → CORRECT: Meta-template improves stale template
dataFlowChanges.impact: Self-improvement loop now functional - stale templates are actually improved instead of re-executed

dataFlowChanges.before: Activity fails → activity.status='failed' → Activity.save() → END (no follow-up)
dataFlowChanges.after: Activity fails → activity.status='failed' → Activity.save() → maybeAutoDebugFailedActivity() → Check config.auto_debug_on_failure → If enabled, trigger debug-activity-self-contained({executionId: failed_activity_id}) → Debug analysis generated → Fix recommendations created
dataFlowChanges.impact: Failed templates now automatically analyzed - root cause identification and fix suggestions generated without manual intervention

architecturalCompliance.mcpAbstraction: MAINTAINED - All lifecycle operations use MCP tools (metabob_register_activity_template, metabob_fetch_boredom_activities, activity_error_inspector). No direct HTTP calls to RPC API.
architecturalCompliance.bootstrapTemplates: CONFIRMED - evolve-activity-self-contained and debug-activity-self-contained are bootstrap templates (embedded in code, always available). No backend dependency for meta-templates.
architecturalCompliance.configDriven: IMPROVED - Added template_lifecycle_automation config section to control automated behaviors. All changes respect config flags (enabled, auto_debug_on_failure, etc.).
architecturalCompliance.nonBlocking: CONFIRMED - Auto-debug is wrapped in try-catch and runs in background session. Failures in lifecycle automation do not block primary activity execution.

remainingGaps.gap: No turn lifecycle hooks for template lifecycle
remainingGaps.reason: Requires coordination with turn-lifecycle-hooks.ts. Current implementation (inline auto-debug in activity.ts) provides immediate value. Lifecycle hooks can be added as enhancement to trigger periodic health checks and evolution based on execution count patterns.
remainingGaps.nextSteps: Add post-activity-completion hook (priority: 125) in turn-lifecycle-hooks.ts to check template health after each activity and trigger evolution if needed. This is an optimization - current inline approach already enables self-improvement.

remainingGaps.reason: maybeAutoDebugFailedActivity() currently triggers debug on every failure instead of checking threshold. Need MCP endpoint to query recent failures by template_id. Current behavior is conservative (more debugging) which is acceptable for initial rollout.
remainingGaps.nextSteps: Implement metabob_get_template_metrics MCP tool or extend existing tools to return failure count. Update maybeAutoDebugFailedActivity() to check threshold before triggering debug.

remainingGaps.reason: BoredomManager maps 'optimize-performance' activity type to 'optimize-activity-self-contained' but this template hasn't been created yet. Will log warning if backend returns this activity type.
remainingGaps.nextSteps: Create optimize-activity-self-contained bootstrap template for performance optimization (reduce token usage, improve execution speed, optimize validation patterns). Can be added in future iteration.
